name: dg-daemon
description: Loopback HTTP+WebSocket daemon hosting many chat sessions for dg:start.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the daemon in the foreground; dg starts this for you

commands.name: status
commands.description: report the live daemon's status, or that none is running

commands.name: start
commands.description: start the daemon in the background, or report the live one

commands.name: stop
commands.description: stop the daemon and its services

options.description: kill the daemon and each service process tree at once

commands.name: restart
commands.description: stop the daemon, then start it again

options.description: kill the daemon and each service process tree at once

commands.name: job
commands.description: manage the background jobs the daemon runs on a schedule

commands.name: add
commands.description: schedule a command that prints one JSON object per item

options.description: how often to run it, e.g. 15m
agent identity to queue new items to

commands.name: list
commands.description: show every scheduled job and its last result

commands.name: rm
commands.description: remove a job and everything it collected

commands.name: enable
commands.description: enable a job without removing it

commands.name: disable
commands.description: disable a job without removing it

commands.name: run
commands.description: run a job now, without waiting for its schedule

commands.name: origin
commands.description: inspect or forget the extension origin the daemon has pinned

commands.name: show
commands.description: print the pinned extension origin, or say none is pinned

commands.name: clear
commands.description: forget the pinned origin so the next connecting extension can pin

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: inspect or clear chat sessions on the running daemon

commands.name: clear
commands.description: close sessions no CLI is attached to

commands.name: service
commands.description: run the long-lived scripts declared under `services` in the daemon config

commands.name: add
commands.description: declare a service in the daemon config

options.description: start it when the daemon starts

commands.name: rm
commands.description: remove a service declaration

commands.name: status
commands.description: show every declared service, or one by label

commands.name: start
commands.description: start a declared service

commands.name: stop
commands.description: stop a declared service

commands.name: completion
commands.description: print the bash, zsh or fish completion script for this program
